steps.content: Among the shattered, hollow carcasses, the <color=#fb9259>Mania Crystals</color> embedded in the weapons become deformed and merge with the contamination, glowing an eerie red.

options: Are they controlled by Mania Crystals?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Surely those little rocks can't be that powerful, right? Hold on. Ted's men used the crystals too, but they didn't turn into this.

options: Something is wrong with the crystals in the weapons.
Something is wrong with this place.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: The Mania Crystals in this crypt apparently possess a will of their own. This has been the case with monsters created from Type 99 Crystals.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: She isn't that kind of person!
That's right. This probably has nothing to do with "99" herself. Its true master is...
Bang! With another wave of throbbing, the aura of the inheritance is getting stronger. As if responding to its call, the monsters before you begin to howl.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: There's no time. We must get through the passage and find the inheritance.
